description_en: Queries the list of new-version data integration tasks. Currently supported task types include MySQL-to-Hologres full-database real-time synchronization tasks
description_zh: 查询数据集成新版任务列表，当前支持的任务类型包括：MySQL到Hologres整库实时同步任务
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-di-jobs --project-id 1967 --job-name mysql_to_holo_sync_8772 --source-data-source-type MySQL --destination-data-source-type Hologres --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDIJobs

parameters.help_en: The task name. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，不填代表不限制，填写支持模糊查询
parameters.name: job_name

parameters.help_en: The source data source type. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 源端数据源类型，不填代表不限制
parameters.name: source_data_source_type

parameters.help_en: The destination data source type. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 目标端数据源类型，不填代表不限制
parameters.name: destination_data_source_type

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认为10，最大支持100
parameters.name: page_size
